annotations.title: Score a rental by its numbers

description: Same check as check_rent, for a rental you describe yourself (when the Zillow lookup is capped, the listing is off Zillow, or you only know the numbers). Needs the monthly rent and a US ZIP; bedrooms, bathrooms, square feet, days listed and property type sharpen it.

days.description: Days the listing has been up.

is_complex.description: True for a unit in a managed apartment building.

type.description: SINGLE_FAMILY, CONDO, TOWNHOUSE, APARTMENT, or MULTI_FAMILY.

name: score_rental
